comparison_scope: One fixed-window, one-shot planning comparison; no repeated prefix or whole-window MPC claim
entry_phase: After current SOC/packet release and before due-command delivery at q

released_nominal_forecast.range_target: Exact duration-weighted quarter mean of same historical qualified ZOH estimate
released_nominal_forecast.demand_slot_semantics: Sum of eight EV ports; no non-EV base load
limitations: Only two selected historical development windows; overlapping pairs are dependent.
Empirical maximum residual does not bound new-day errors or establish coverage.
Naive logger clock and original zero-delay release model; actual arrival and device clock accuracy unproven.
No history-backed range beyond the last ready lead; missing leads must refuse support.
Current-point persistence is unchanged and may forecast the wrong future supply-demand direction.

released_empirical_pointwise_forecast.range_target: Within-quarter minimum/maximum of original-age-qualified historical native ZOH estimate; not physical truth
released_empirical_pointwise_forecast.demand_slot_semantics: Sum of eight EV ports; no non-EV base load
limitations: Only two selected historical development windows; overlapping pairs are dependent.
Empirical maximum residual does not bound new-day errors or establish coverage.
Naive logger clock and original zero-delay release model; actual arrival and device clock accuracy unproven.
No history-backed range beyond the last ready lead; missing leads must refuse support.
Current-point persistence is unchanged and may forecast the wrong future supply-demand direction.

forecast_scope: Both planners use the same current-point persistence and held nominal reserve; empirical pointwise ranges are recorded separately and are not a coverage certificate.
